decisions.reason: The building data digital twin service still targets an emerging market with unresolved demand, so the firm keeps the option open while uncertainty is high and the cost of maintaining it is acceptable.
This open GIS application development framework is central to the firm's component strategy and has low continuation costs, so the option is retained.
The identity and access service for GIS applications has low incremental cost and remains close to the established offer, so the firm keeps the option open.
The geodata business process consulting workshop is low-cost and directly monetizable, so the firm keeps this option while it evaluates demand.
